title: Le venticinque stanze
designed_property: King 5x5 exact 2D UDG (atom positions = page positions)
paper: Jurczak 2026, arXiv (QOuLiPo: What a quantum computer sees when it reads a book)
description: 25-page Italian constrained text arranged on a 5x5 king graph. Each page is a room in a palazzo; king-adjacent rooms share characters, objects, and plot threads. Non-adjacent rooms are unrelated. The graph is an exact 2D unit-disk graph by construction: atom positions are the grid coordinates themselves.
style: Calvino (Se una notte d'inverno un viaggiatore / Le citta invisibili)
author: Constrained text (QOuLiPo project)
